question: 2003 నుంచి ఏ టిములు వరుసగా వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఫినల్స్ ఓడిపోయారు? టీం యొక్క పేరు మరియు మ్యాచులు ఆడిన సంవత్సరాలు రాయండి.
query: WITH finals AS (SELECT match_id, match_date, CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN team2 WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN team1 ELSE 'New Zealand' END AS losing_team, CAST(strftime('%Y', match_date) AS INTEGER) AS year FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'Final') SELECT f1.losing_team AS team_name, f1.year AS year1, f2.year AS year2 FROM finals f1 JOIN finals f2 ON f1.losing_team = f2.losing_team AND f2.year = f1.year + 4 ORDER BY team_name;
generated_sql:
SELECT m.team1 AS team, m.season
FROM Matches m
WHERE m.stage LIKE '%Final%' AND m.match_winner = m.team2
  AND m.season >= '2003'
UNION
SELECT m.team2 AS team, m.season
FROM Matches m
WHERE m.stage LIKE '%Final%' AND m.match_winner = m.team1
  AND m.season >= '2003'
ORDER BY team, season;

query: WITH finals AS (SELECT match_id, match_date, CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN team2 WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN team1 ELSE 'New Zealand' END AS losing_team, CAST(strftime('%Y', match_date) AS INTEGER) AS year FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'Final') SELECT f1.losing_team AS team_name, f1.year AS year1, f2.year AS year2 FROM finals f1 JOIN finals f2 ON f1.losing_team = f2.losing_team AND f2.year = f1.year + 4 ORDER BY team_name;

question: 2002 के बाद के ODI विश्व कप में सबसे बड़े सफल रन चेज़ कौन से रहे? सीज़न, विजेता टीम, स्कोर, विपक्षी टीम और स्थान बताइए।
query: WITH innings_totals AS ( SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, SUM(D.runs_scored) + SUM(D.extra_runs) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team ) SELECT M.season, M.match_winner AS winning_team, I.total_runs AS chase_score, CASE WHEN M.match_winner = M.team1 THEN M.team2 ELSE M.team1 END AS opponent, M.city FROM Matches M JOIN innings_totals I ON M.match_id = I.match_id AND I.batting_team = M.match_winner WHERE M.result_type = 'wickets' AND CAST(substr(M.season, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 2002 ORDER BY chase_score DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    m.season,
    m.match_winner AS winner_team,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score,
    CASE WHEN m.match_winner = m.team1 THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent_team,
    m.venue
FROM Matches m
JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE m.season > '2002' 
    AND m.stage LIKE '%Final%' 
    AND m.result_type = 'wickets'
    AND d.batting_team = m.match_winner
GROUP BY m.match_id
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: 2002 ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਦੇ ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੇ ਸਫਲ ਰਨ ਚੇਜ਼ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਰਹੇ? ਸੀਜ਼ਨ, ਜੇਤੂ ਟੀਮ, ਸਕੋਰ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਦਾਨ ਦੱਸੋ।

question: 2003 से, किन टीमों ने लगातार विश्व कप फाइनल हारे? टीम का नाम और उन मैचों के वर्ष बताएं।
query: WITH finals AS (SELECT match_id, match_date, CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN team2 WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN team1 ELSE 'New Zealand' END AS losing_team, CAST(strftime('%Y', match_date) AS INTEGER) AS year FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'Final') SELECT f1.losing_team AS team_name, f1.year AS year1, f2.year AS year2 FROM finals f1 JOIN finals f2 ON f1.losing_team = f2.losing_team AND f2.year = f1.year + 4 ORDER BY team_name;

SELECT m.team1 AS team, strftime('%Y', m.match_date) AS year
FROM Matches m
WHERE m.stage = 'Final' AND m.match_winner != m.team1 AND m.team1 IN (
    SELECT team1
    FROM Matches
    WHERE stage = 'Final' AND match_winner != team1

question: From the 2002/03 ODI World Cup season onwards, who scored the most centuries in a single ODI World Cup edition? Mention the player name, season and number of centuries.
query: WITH innings AS ( SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season ) SELECT P.player_name, I.season, COUNT(*) AS centuries FROM innings I JOIN Players P ON I.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE I.runs >= 100 GROUP BY P.player_name, I.season ORDER BY centuries DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, m.season, COUNT(*) AS centuries
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season >= '2002/03'
GROUP BY m.season, p.player_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100
ORDER BY centuries DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: 2002/03 ODI विश्व कप सीज़न से, एक ODI विश्व कप संस्करण में सबसे अधिक शतक किसने बनाए? खिलाड़ी का नाम, सीज़न और शतकों की संख्या बताइए।
query: WITH innings AS ( SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season ) SELECT P.player_name, I.season, COUNT(*) AS centuries FROM innings I JOIN Players P ON I.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE I.runs >= 100 GROUP BY P.player_name, I.season ORDER BY centuries DESC LIMIT 10;

FROM Deliveries d

question: 2002 తర్వాత జరిగిన ODI వరల్డ్ కప్పుల్లో అత్యంత విజయవంతమైన రన్ ఛేజ్‌లు ఏమిటి? సీజన్, గెలిచిన జట్టు, స్కోర్, ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టు మరియు వేదికను పేర్కొనండి.
query: WITH innings_totals AS ( SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, SUM(D.runs_scored) + SUM(D.extra_runs) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team ) SELECT M.season, M.match_winner AS winning_team, I.total_runs AS chase_score, CASE WHEN M.match_winner = M.team1 THEN M.team2 ELSE M.team1 END AS opponent, M.city FROM Matches M JOIN innings_totals I ON M.match_id = I.match_id AND I.batting_team = M.match_winner WHERE M.result_type = 'wickets' AND CAST(substr(M.season, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 2002 ORDER BY chase_score DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT

    m.match_winner AS winning_team,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score,

question: विश्व कप में नंबर 5 या उससे नीचे बल्लेबाजी करते हुए किन खिलाड़ियों ने सबसे अधिक 50+ स्कोर बनाए? स्कोर की संख्या, खिलाड़ी का नाम और सीज़न बताएं।
query: WITH batter_innings AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id, MIN(D.delivery_id) AS first_ball, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id), positions AS (SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id, runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY first_ball) AS batting_pos FROM batter_innings) SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS fifties FROM positions POS JOIN Matches M ON POS.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON POS.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE POS.runs >= 50 AND POS.batting_pos >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY fifties DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score,
    p.player_name,
    m.season,
    COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_count
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE d.inning IN (1, 2)
    AND d.batting_team = (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE match_id = d.match_id AND player_id = d.striker_id)
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, p.player_name, m.season
HAVING score >= 50
    AND (
        SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team 
            ORDER BY MIN(d2.delivery_id)
        )
        FROM Deliveries d2
        WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id 
            AND d2.inning = d.inning 
            AND d2.batting_team = d.batting_team 
            AND d2.striker_id = d.striker_id
        GROUP BY d2.striker_id
    ) >= 5
ORDER BY fifty_plus_count DESC, score DESC;

question: ਨੰਬਰ 5 ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਰਦਿਆਂ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ 50+ ਸਕੋਰ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਹਨ? ਸਕੋਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ, ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਦੱਸੋ।
query: WITH batter_innings AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id, MIN(D.delivery_id) AS first_ball, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id), positions AS (SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id, runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY first_ball) AS batting_pos FROM batter_innings) SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS fifties FROM positions POS JOIN Matches M ON POS.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON POS.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE POS.runs >= 50 AND POS.batting_pos >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY fifties DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    m.season,
    COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE d.inning = 1 OR d.inning = 2
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, p.player_name, m.season
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50
ORDER BY fifty_plus_scores DESC, p.player_name, m.season;

question: 2002/03 ODI विश्व कप सीज़न के बाद, ODI विश्व कप इतिहास में सबसे बड़े पावरप्ले स्कोर किन टीमों ने बनाए? टीम, सीज़न, विपक्षी टीम और पावरप्ले रन बताइए।
query: SELECT D.batting_team AS team, M.season, CASE WHEN D.batting_team = M.team1 THEN M.team2 ELSE M.team1 END AS opponent, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS powerplay_runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE D.over_number < 10 AND CAST(substr(M.season,1,4) AS INTEGER) >= 2002 GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team ORDER BY powerplay_runs DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    d.batting_team AS team,
    m.season,
    CASE 
        WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 
        ELSE m.team1 
    END AS opponent_team,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS powerplay_runs
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season != '2002/03'
  AND d.inning IN (1, 2)
  AND d.over_number BETWEEN 1 AND 10
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, m.season, m.team1, m.team2
ORDER BY powerplay_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which players have the most wickets in powerplay 1 in the 2019 World Cup? Mention the player name and the number of wickets.
query: SELECT P.player_name, COUNT(*) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE M.season = '2019' AND D.over_number < 10 AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY P.player_name ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS wickets
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.season = '2019'
  AND d.inning IN (1, 2)
  AND d.over_number BETWEEN 1 AND 10
  AND d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
  AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'hit wicket')
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name

question: ఏ క్రీడాకార్లు వరల్డ్ కప్పులో నెంబర్ 5 లేదా దానికన్నా తక్కువ స్థానంలో బ్యాటింగ్ చేసేదప్పుడు అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ అర్ధ శతాబ్దాలు సంపాదించారు? అర్ధ శతాబ్దాల సంఖ్య, క్రీడాకార్లు మరియు సీజన్ రాయండి.
query: WITH batter_innings AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id, MIN(D.delivery_id) AS first_ball, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id), positions AS (SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id, runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY first_ball) AS batting_pos FROM batter_innings) SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS fifties FROM positions POS JOIN Matches M ON POS.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON POS.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE POS.runs >= 50 AND POS.batting_pos >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY fifties DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(*) AS half_centuries,
    m.season
FROM 
    Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            match_id, 
            inning, 
            striker_id,
            SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY MIN(delivery_id)) AS batting_position
        FROM 
            Deliveries
        GROUP BY 
            match_id, inning, striker_id
    ) AS batting_order ON d.match_id = batting_order.match_id 
        AND d.inning = batting_order.inning 
        AND d.striker_id = batting_order.striker_id
WHERE 
    batting_order.batting_position <= 5
    AND m.season LIKE 'World Cup%'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name, m.season
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    half_centuries DESC, m.season;

question: Which players have the most 50+ scores in a World Cup while batting at No 5 or below? Mention the number of scores, the player and the season.
query: WITH batter_innings AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id, MIN(D.delivery_id) AS first_ball, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id), positions AS (SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id, runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY first_ball) AS batting_pos FROM batter_innings) SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS fifties FROM positions POS JOIN Matches M ON POS.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON POS.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE POS.runs >= 50 AND POS.batting_pos >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY fifties DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_count,
    m.season
FROM 
    Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    d.inning IN (1, 2)
    AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY 
    m.season, p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.inning
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
INTERSECT
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_count,
    m.season
FROM 
    Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            match_id,
            batting_team,
            MIN(delivery_id) AS first_delivery
        FROM 
            Deliveries
        WHERE 
            inning IN (1, 2)
        GROUP BY 
            match_id, batting_team
    ) AS openers ON d.match_id = openers.match_id AND d.batting_team = openers.batting_team
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            match_id,
            batting_team,
            striker_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY MIN(delivery_id)) AS batting_position
        FROM 
            Deliveries
        WHERE 
            inning IN (1, 2)
        GROUP BY 
            match_id, batting_team, striker_id
    ) AS positions ON d.striker_id = positions.striker_id AND d.match_id = positions.match_id AND d.batting_team = positions.batting_team
WHERE 
    positions.batting_position >= 5
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name, m.season
ORDER BY 
    fifty_plus_count DESC;

question: Which team took the highest average number of balls to reach a fifty in the 2019 ODI World Cup? Mention the team and the average balls taken.
query: WITH cumulative AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, D.batting_team, D.over_number, D.ball_number, SUM(D.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS running_runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE M.season = '2019'), milestone AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, batting_team, MIN(balls_faced) AS balls_to_50 FROM cumulative WHERE running_runs >= 50 GROUP BY match_id, striker_id) SELECT batting_team, ROUND(AVG(balls_to_50), 0) AS avg_balls_to_50 FROM milestone GROUP BY batting_team ORDER BY avg_balls_to_50 DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    d.batting_team AS team,
    AVG(d.delivery_id - MIN(d.delivery_id) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team) + 1) AS avg_balls_to_fifty
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season = '2019'
GROUP BY d.batting_team, d.match_id, d.inning
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50
ORDER BY avg_balls_to_fifty DESC

query: WITH cumulative AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, D.batting_team, D.over_number, D.ball_number, SUM(D.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS running_runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE M.season = '2019'), milestone AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, batting_team, MIN(balls_faced) AS balls_to_50 FROM cumulative WHERE running_runs >= 50 GROUP BY match_id, striker_id) SELECT batting_team, ROUND(AVG(balls_to_50), 0) AS avg_balls_to_50 FROM milestone GROUP BY batting_team ORDER BY avg_balls_to_50 DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    d.batting_team,
    AVG(CASE 
        WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 
        ELSE NULL 
    END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END), 0), 0) AS avg_balls_per_fifty
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season = '2019'

GROUP BY d.batting_team
ORDER BY avg_balls_per_fifty ASC

question: In New Zealand's three matches before the 2019 ODI World Cup final, what were their powerplay scores? Mention the stage and the powerplay score.
query: WITH nz_matches AS ( SELECT match_id, match_date, stage FROM Matches WHERE season = '2019' AND stage != 'Final' AND (team1 = 'New Zealand' OR team2 = 'New Zealand') ORDER BY match_date DESC LIMIT 3 ), pp1_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D JOIN nz_matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE D.batting_team = 'New Zealand' AND D.over_number < 10 GROUP BY D.match_id ) SELECT CASE WHEN M.stage = 'League' THEN 'Group' ELSE M.stage END AS stage, P.runs || '/' || P.wickets AS powerplay_score FROM pp1_scores P JOIN nz_matches M ON P.match_id = M.match_id ORDER BY M.match_date;

JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id

question: After JC Archer, MA Wood and CR Woakes, which England bowler recorded the fourth highest wicket tally in a single World Cup edition from 2003 onwards? Mention the player name, season and number of wickets.

question: 2019 ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਔਸਤ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਚਾਸਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ? ਟੀਮ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਔਸਤ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦੱਸੋ।
query: WITH cumulative AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, D.batting_team, D.over_number, D.ball_number, SUM(D.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS running_runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE M.season = '2019'), milestone AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, batting_team, MIN(balls_faced) AS balls_to_50 FROM cumulative WHERE running_runs >= 50 GROUP BY match_id, striker_id) SELECT batting_team, ROUND(AVG(balls_to_50), 0) AS avg_balls_to_50 FROM milestone GROUP BY batting_team ORDER BY avg_balls_to_50 DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT team_name, AVG(balls_faced) AS avg_balls_for_fifty
FROM (
    SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, t.team_name,
           SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_in_innings,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN PlayerInMatch t ON d.match_id = t.match_id AND d.striker_id = t.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = '2019' AND m.stage = 'Group'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, t.team_name
    HAVING runs_in_innings >= 50
) AS fifties
GROUP BY team_name
ORDER BY avg_balls_for_fifty ASC
LIMIT 1;

query: WITH second_inning AS ( SELECT D.match_id, M.season, M.team1, M.team2, M.city, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS running_total, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 ), fifth_wicket_score AS ( SELECT match_id, season, team1, team2, city, MIN(running_total) FILTER (WHERE wickets_fallen = 5) AS score_at_5, MAX(running_total) AS final_score FROM second_inning GROUP BY match_id ) SELECT season, team1, team2, city, (final_score - score_at_5) AS last_five_wickets_runs FROM fifth_wicket_score ORDER BY last_five_wickets_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    m.season,
    m.team1,
    m.team2,
    m.venue,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_added
FROM 
    Matches m
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    d.inning = 2

          AND d2.delivery_id <= d.delivery_id 
          AND d2.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
    ) >= 5
GROUP BY

    runs_added DESC
LIMIT 1;

query: SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS catches FROM FielderDismissals F JOIN Deliveries D ON F.delivery_id = D.delivery_id JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON F.fielder_id = P.player_id WHERE D.wicket_type = 'caught' GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY catches DESC, CAST(SUBSTR(M.season,1,4) AS INTEGER) DESC, P.player_name ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 2002/03 के बाद ODI विश्व कप के एक संस्करण में सबसे अधिक 50-प्लस स्कोर किन बल्लेबाज़ों ने बनाए? खिलाड़ी का नाम, सीज़न और 50-प्लस स्कोर की संख्या बताइए।
query: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season ), fifty_plus AS ( SELECT striker_id, season, COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores FROM innings_scores WHERE runs >= 50 GROUP BY striker_id, season ) SELECT P.player_name, F.season, F.fifty_plus_scores FROM fifty_plus F JOIN Players P ON F.striker_id = P.player_id ORDER BY fifty_plus_scores DESC LIMIT 4;

FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season > '2002/03'
  AND d.inning IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY m.match_id, m.inning, d.striker_id, p.player_name, m.season
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50
ORDER BY fifty_plus_count DESC, p.player_name
LIMIT 1;

question: ODI వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఇతిహాసలో విజయవంతమైన రన్ చేసులో అన్నిటికన్నా పెద్ద లోవర్ ఆర్డర్ రికవరీ ఏమిటి? (ఐదవ వికెట్ పడిపోయిన తరువాత సంపాదించిన పరుగులు)
query: WITH chase_wins AS ( SELECT match_id, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE result_type = 'wickets' ), wicket_sequence AS ( SELECT D.match_id, (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number AS ball_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY D.match_id ORDER BY (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number ) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') ), fifth_wicket_ball AS ( SELECT match_id, ball_seq AS ball_at_5w FROM wicket_sequence WHERE wicket_num = 5 ), score_at_5w AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs_at_5w FROM Deliveries D JOIN fifth_wicket_ball F ON D.match_id = F.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number <= F.ball_at_5w GROUP BY D.match_id ), final_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS final_score FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 GROUP BY D.match_id ) SELECT M.season, C.match_winner, (F.final_score - W.runs_at_5w) AS recovery_runs FROM score_at_5w W JOIN final_scores F ON W.match_id = F.match_id JOIN chase_wins C ON C.match_id = W.match_id JOIN Matches M ON M.match_id = W.match_id ORDER BY recovery_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT MAX(recovery_runs) AS max_lower_order_recovery
FROM (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS recovery_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field', 'handled the ball', 'timed out', 'hit the ball twice')
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, (
        SELECT COUNT(*) 
        FROM Deliveries d2 
        WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id 
          AND d2.inning = d.inning 
          AND d2.delivery_id <= d.delivery_id 
          AND d2.player_out_id IS NOT NULL 
          AND d2.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field', 'handled the ball', 'timed out', 'hit the ball twice')
    )
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) >= 5

query: WITH chase_wins AS ( SELECT match_id, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE result_type = 'wickets' ), wicket_sequence AS ( SELECT D.match_id, (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number AS ball_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY D.match_id ORDER BY (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number ) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') ), fifth_wicket_ball AS ( SELECT match_id, ball_seq AS ball_at_5w FROM wicket_sequence WHERE wicket_num = 5 ), score_at_5w AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs_at_5w FROM Deliveries D JOIN fifth_wicket_ball F ON D.match_id = F.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number <= F.ball_at_5w GROUP BY D.match_id ), final_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS final_score FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 GROUP BY D.match_id ) SELECT M.season, C.match_winner, (F.final_score - W.runs_at_5w) AS recovery_runs FROM score_at_5w W JOIN final_scores F ON W.match_id = F.match_id JOIN chase_wins C ON C.match_id = W.match_id JOIN Matches M ON M.match_id = W.match_id ORDER BY recovery_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(partnership_runs) AS max_lower_order_recovery
FROM (
    SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id,
           SUM(d.runs_scored) AS partnership_runs,
           SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning
               ORDER BY d.delivery_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS wickets_fallen
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.result_type = 'wickets' AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id, wickets_fallen
    HAVING wickets_fallen >= 5
) AS subquery;

question: What is the largest lower-order recovery in a successful run chase in ODI World Cup history (runs added after the fall of the fifth wicket)?
query: WITH chase_wins AS ( SELECT match_id, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE result_type = 'wickets' ), wicket_sequence AS ( SELECT D.match_id, (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number AS ball_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY D.match_id ORDER BY (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number ) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') ), fifth_wicket_ball AS ( SELECT match_id, ball_seq AS ball_at_5w FROM wicket_sequence WHERE wicket_num = 5 ), score_at_5w AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs_at_5w FROM Deliveries D JOIN fifth_wicket_ball F ON D.match_id = F.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number <= F.ball_at_5w GROUP BY D.match_id ), final_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS final_score FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 GROUP BY D.match_id ) SELECT M.season, C.match_winner, (F.final_score - W.runs_at_5w) AS recovery_runs FROM score_at_5w W JOIN final_scores F ON W.match_id = F.match_id JOIN chase_wins C ON C.match_id = W.match_id JOIN Matches M ON M.match_id = W.match_id ORDER BY recovery_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT MAX(recovery_runs) AS largest_lower_order_recovery
FROM (
    SELECT d.match_id, d.inning,
           SUM(d.runs_scored) AS recovery_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.result_type = 'wickets'
      AND d.inning = 2
      AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field', 'handled the ball', 'timed out', 'hit the ball twice')
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM Deliveries d2
        WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id
          AND d2.inning = d.inning
          AND d2.delivery_id <= d.delivery_id
          AND d2.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field', 'handled the ball', 'timed out', 'hit the ball twice')
    ) HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
) AS recovery;

query: SELECT P.player_name, Innings.batting_team AS opponent, COUNT(*) AS five_fors FROM (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, batting_team, COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS wkts FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id) AS Innings JOIN Players AS P ON Innings.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE Innings.wkts >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name, opponent HAVING five_fors >= 2;

FROM Deliveries d

JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id

GROUP BY m.season, d.bowler_id, m.team1, m.team2
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

question: What were AB de Villiers' batting stats in the 2015 ODI World Cup? Mention the number of matches played, innings, total runs, hundreds, average, and strike rate.
query: WITH innings AS (SELECT D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, MAX(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id = D.striker_id AND D.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE P.player_name = 'AB de Villiers' AND M.season = '2014/15' GROUP BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hundreds, ROUND(SUM(runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(dismissed), 0), 2) AS avg, ROUND(SUM(runs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(balls), 0), 2) AS sr FROM innings;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS matches_played,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 AND m.inning = 1 OR d.batting_team = m.team2 AND m.inning = 2 THEN d.match_id END) AS innings,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hundreds,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = p.player_id THEN 1 END), 0) AS average,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END), 0) AS strike_rate
FROM Players p
JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'AB de Villiers' AND m.season = '2015' AND m.stage = 'Group';

question: ఒకే ODI ప్రపంచకప్ ఎడిషన్‌లో అత్యధిక పరుగులు చేసిన వికెట్ కీపర్ ఎవరు? పరుగుల ఆధారంగా టాప్ 2 చూపించండి.
query: WITH keepers AS (SELECT DISTINCT FD.fielder_id AS keeper_id FROM FielderDismissals FD JOIN Deliveries D ON FD.delivery_id = D.delivery_id WHERE D.wicket_type = 'stumped'), innings AS (SELECT D.striker_id, M.season, D.match_id, D.inning, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id = D.striker_id AND D.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.striker_id, M.season, D.match_id, D.inning) SELECT P.player_name AS player, I.season, SUM(I.runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(DISTINCT I.match_id) AS matches, ROUND(SUM(I.runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(I.dismissed), 0), 2) AS avg FROM innings I JOIN keepers K ON I.striker_id = K.keeper_id JOIN Players P ON I.striker_id = P.player_id GROUP BY I.striker_id, I.season ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id

WHERE m.season IN (
    SELECT season

query: SELECT match_winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS knockout_wins FROM Matches WHERE stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') AND season < 2023 AND match_winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY match_winner ORDER BY knockout_wins DESC, team LIMIT 3;

question: Before the 2023 ODI Cricket World Cup, which teams had won the most World Cup semi-final and final matches combined? Return the top 3 teams along with number of matches won.
query: SELECT match_winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS knockout_wins FROM Matches WHERE stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') AND season < 2023 AND match_winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY match_winner ORDER BY knockout_wins DESC, team LIMIT 3;

question: What are M Muralitharan's overall bowling stats across all ODI World Cup editions?

    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL 
               AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled','caught','caught and bowled','lbw','stumped','hit wicket')

    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END), 0) AS economy_rate,

    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL 
               AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled','caught','caught and bowled','lbw','stumped','hit wicket')

JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'M Muralitharan';

    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled','caught','caught and bowled','lbw','stumped','hit wicket') THEN 1 END) AS wickets,
    ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END), 0) * 6, 2) AS economy,
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled','caught','caught and bowled','lbw','stumped','hit wicket') THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS strike_rate,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled','caught','caught and bowled','lbw','stumped','hit wicket') THEN 1 END) AS wickets
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'M Muralitharan'
GROUP BY m.season
ORDER BY m.season;

query: WITH innings AS (SELECT D.striker_id, M.season, D.match_id, D.inning, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, MAX(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id = D.striker_id AND D.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE P.player_name = 'CH Gayle' AND M.season = 2019 GROUP BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning) SELECT season, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(runs) AS total_runs, ROUND(SUM(runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(dismissed), 0), 2) AS avg, ROUND(SUM(runs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(balls), 0), 2) AS sr FROM innings GROUP BY season ORDER BY season;

question: ਇੱਕ ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਦੌੜਾਂ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਵਿਕਟਕੀਪਰ ਕੌਣ ਸੀ? ਦੌੜਾਂ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰ 'ਤੇ ਟਾਪ 2 ਦਿਖਾਓ।
query: WITH keepers AS (SELECT DISTINCT FD.fielder_id AS keeper_id FROM FielderDismissals FD JOIN Deliveries D ON FD.delivery_id = D.delivery_id WHERE D.wicket_type = 'stumped'), innings AS (SELECT D.striker_id, M.season, D.match_id, D.inning, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id = D.striker_id AND D.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.striker_id, M.season, D.match_id, D.inning) SELECT P.player_name AS player, I.season, SUM(I.runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(DISTINCT I.match_id) AS matches, ROUND(SUM(I.runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(I.dismissed), 0), 2) AS avg FROM innings I JOIN keepers K ON I.striker_id = K.keeper_id JOIN Players P ON I.striker_id = P.player_id GROUP BY I.striker_id, I.season ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON d.match_id = pm.match_id AND d.striker_id = pm.player_id
WHERE pm.team_name IN ('India', 'Australia', 'England', 'New Zealand', 'South Africa', 'Pakistan', 'Sri Lanka', 'West Indies', 'Bangladesh', 'Zimbabwe', 'Ireland', 'Afghanistan', 'Netherlands', 'Scotland', 'Papua New Guinea', 'Kenya', 'Canada', 'USA', 'Namibia', 'UAE', 'Bermuda', 'Oman', 'Hong Kong', 'Nepal', 'Papua New Guinea')
AND d.batting_team = pm.team_name
AND (d.wides > 0 OR d.noballs > 0 OR d.byes > 0 OR d.legbyes > 0 OR d.runs_scored > 0)
AND d.striker_id IN (
    SELECT player_id
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    WHERE team_name IN ('India', 'Australia', 'England', 'New Zealand', 'South Africa', 'Pakistan', 'Sri Lanka', 'West Indies', 'Bangladesh', 'Zimbabwe', 'Ireland', 'Afghanistan', 'Netherlands', 'Scotland', 'Papua New Guinea', 'Kenya', 'Canada', 'USA', 'Namibia', 'UAE', 'Bermuda', 'Oman', 'Hong Kong', 'Nepal', 'Papua New Guinea')
    GROUP BY player_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'caught' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
)
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 2;

question: ODI विश्व कप इतिहास में सबसे तेज़ अर्धशतक (सबसे कम गेंदों में) लगाने वाले बल्लेबाज कौन हैं? शीर्ष 5 पारियाँ दिखाइए।
query: WITH ball_progress AS (SELECT D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning, M.season, D.delivery_id, SUM(D.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning ORDER BY D.delivery_id) AS cumulative_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning ORDER BY D.delivery_id) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id), milestones AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, season, MIN(balls_faced) AS balls_to_fifty FROM ball_progress WHERE cumulative_runs >= 50 GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning, season), innings AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning) SELECT P.player_name AS player, M.season, I.runs, MS.balls_to_fifty FROM milestones MS JOIN innings I ON MS.striker_id=I.striker_id AND MS.match_id=I.match_id AND MS.inning=I.inning JOIN Players P ON MS.striker_id=P.player_id JOIN Matches M ON MS.match_id=M.match_id ORDER BY balls_to_fifty ASC, runs DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id

question: ਸਾਰੇ ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ M Muralitharan ਦੇ ਸਮੁੱਚੇ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਅੰਕੜੇ ਕੀ ਹਨ?
query: SELECT P.player_name AS player, COUNT(DISTINCT D.match_id) AS matches, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, ROUND(SUM(D.runs_scored + D.wides + D.noballs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS avg, ROUND(SUM(D.runs_scored + D.wides + D.noballs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS economy FROM Deliveries D JOIN Players P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE P.player_name = 'M Muralitharan' GROUP BY D.bowler_id;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_bowled,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL 
        AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled','caught','caught and bowled','lbw','stumped','hit wicket') 
        THEN 1 END) AS wickets,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS FLOAT) * 6.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END), 2)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS economy_rate,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL 
            AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled','caught','caught and bowled','lbw','stumped','hit wicket') 
            THEN 1 END) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL 
            AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled','caught','caught and bowled','lbw','stumped','hit wicket') 
            THEN 1 END), 2)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS bowling_average,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL 
            AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled','caught','caught and bowled','lbw','stumped','hit wicket') 
            THEN 1 END) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL 
            AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled','caught','caught and bowled','lbw','stumped','hit wicket') 
            THEN 1 END), 2)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS strike_rate
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'M Muralitharan';

question: Which teams have the best win percentage in ODI World Cup history among teams that have played at least 20 matches? Show the top 5.

    COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN team_name = match_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS win_percentage

    UNION ALL
    SELECT team2 AS team_name, match_winner FROM Matches
) AS all_matches
GROUP BY team_name

LIMIT 5;

question: అన్ని ODI ప్రపంచకప్ ఎడిషన్లలో వికెట్ కీపర్లతో సహా అత్యధిక క్యాచ్‌లు పట్టిన టాప్ 5 ఫీల్డర్లు ఎవరు?
query: SELECT P.player_name AS player, COUNT(*) AS catches FROM FielderDismissals FD JOIN Deliveries D ON FD.delivery_id = D.delivery_id JOIN Players P ON FD.fielder_id = P.player_id WHERE D.wicket_type IN ('caught','caught and bowled') GROUP BY FD.fielder_id, P.player_name ORDER BY catches DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS catch_count
FROM FielderDismissals fd
JOIN Players p ON fd.fielder_id = p.player_id
JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'stumped')
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY catch_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: కనీసం 20 మ్యాచ్‌లు ఆడిన జట్లలో ODI ప్రపంచకప్ చరిత్రలో అత్యుత్తమ గెలుపు శాతం ఏ జట్లకు ఉంది? టాప్ 5 చూపించండి.
query: WITH team_matches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS matches, SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS win_pct FROM team_matches GROUP BY team HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY win_pct DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    team_name,
    COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN team_name = match_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS win_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT team1 AS team_name, match_winner FROM Matches
    UNION ALL
    SELECT team2 AS team_name, match_winner FROM Matches
) AS team_matches
GROUP BY team_name
HAVING matches_played >= 20
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC, matches_played DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Does winning the toss and choosing to bat vs field affect a team's win rate in ODI World Cup matches?
query: SELECT toss_decision, COUNT(*) AS matches, SUM(CASE WHEN toss_winner = match_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS toss_winner_won, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN toss_winner = match_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),2) AS win_pct FROM Matches WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY toss_decision;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    toss_decision,
    COUNT(*) AS total_matches,
    SUM(CASE WHEN team1 = toss_winner AND team1 = match_winner THEN 1
             WHEN team2 = toss_winner AND team2 = match_winner THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
    AVG(CASE WHEN team1 = toss_winner AND team1 = match_winner THEN 1.0
             WHEN team2 = toss_winner AND team2 = match_winner THEN 1.0
             ELSE 0.0 END) AS win_rate
FROM Matches
WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY toss_decision;

question: ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 20 ਮੈਚ ਖੇਡਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਜਿੱਤ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਹੈ? ਟਾਪ 5 ਦਿਖਾਓ।
query: WITH team_matches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS matches, SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS win_pct FROM team_matches GROUP BY team HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY win_pct DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:

    team_name,
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = team_name THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS win_percentage

) AS team_matches

question: ODI विश्व कप इतिहास में किसी एक पारी में टीम द्वारा बनाए गए सबसे बड़े स्कोर कौन से हैं? शीर्ष 5 दिखाइए।
query: WITH team_innings AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.inning, D.batting_team, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.match_id, D.inning, D.batting_team, M.season) SELECT batting_team, season, total_runs FROM team_innings ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5;

question: ODI विश्व कप इतिहास में टीम द्वारा बनाए गए सबसे कम पूर्ण (ऑल-आउट) स्कोर कौन-से हैं? शीर्ष 5 पारियाँ दिखाइए।
query: WITH team_innings AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.inning, D.batting_team, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_lost FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.match_id, D.inning, D.batting_team, M.season) SELECT batting_team, season, total_runs, wickets_lost FROM team_innings WHERE wickets_lost = 10 ORDER BY total_runs ASC LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    m.match_id,
    d.batting_team,
    m.match_date,
    m.venue,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score
FROM 
    Matches m
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE 
    d.inning IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY 
    m.match_id, d.match_id, d.batting_team, m.match_date, m.venue

    total_score ASC

question: ODI विश्व कप इतिहास में सबसे अधिक बार शून्य (डक) पर आउट होने वाले बल्लेबाज कौन हैं? शीर्ष 5 दिखाइए।

query: WITH bowler_stats AS (SELECT D.bowler_id, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wkts, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.wides + D.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.bowler_id) SELECT P.player_name AS player, B.wkts, B.runs_conceded, ROUND(B.runs_conceded*1.0/B.wkts,2) AS avg FROM bowler_stats B JOIN Players P ON B.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE B.wkts >= 20 ORDER BY avg ASC LIMIT 5;

question: What were Trent Boult's bowling figures in the powerplay overs (overs 1-10) during New Zealand's 2015 World Cup quarter-final against West Indies?
query: SELECT P.player_name AS player, M.team1, M.team2, M.season, M.match_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN D.wides=0 AND D.noballs=0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.wides + D.noballs) AS runs_conceded, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D JOIN Players P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE P.player_name='TA Boult' AND M.season='2014/15' AND M.team1='New Zealand' AND M.team2='West Indies' AND D.over_number<=9 GROUP BY D.bowler_id, D.match_id, P.player_name, M.team1, M.team2, M.season, M.match_date;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_bowled,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL 
               AND d.wicket_type IN ('bowled','caught','caught and bowled','lbw','stumped','hit wicket') 
          THEN 1 END) AS wickets
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'T Boult'
  AND m.season = '2015'
  AND m.team1 IN ('New Zealand', 'West Indies') 
  AND m.team2 IN ('New Zealand', 'West Indies')
  AND 'New Zealand' IN (m.team1, m.team2)
  AND m.stage LIKE '%Quarter%'
  AND d.bowling_team = 'New Zealand'
  AND d.over_number BETWEEN 1 AND 10;

query: SELECT D.inning, D.batting_team, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D WHERE D.match_id = (SELECT match_id FROM Matches WHERE season='2019' AND stage='Final') GROUP BY D.inning, D.batting_team ORDER BY D.inning;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    d.inning,
    m.team1,
    m.team2,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field', 'handled the ball', 'timed out', 'hit the ball twice') THEN 1 END) AS wickets_lost
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    m.season = '2019' 
    AND m.stage = 'Final' 
    AND ((m.team1 = 'England' AND m.team2 = 'New Zealand') OR (m.team1 = 'New Zealand' AND m.team2 = 'England'))
    AND m.result_type = 'tie'
GROUP BY 
    d.match_id, d.inning, m.team1, m.team2
ORDER BY 
    d.inning;
